summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend E2E testing of AI Marketing Engine. Backend: 14/14 tests pass (auth login/logout/register/me, unauth guard, Strategy AI generation with structured JSON schema, Content text + Gemini image (base64 data URL), Leads CRUD + AI scoring + stage update, Sales Assistant AI, Campaigns CRUD with computed CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS/ROI verified, Social generate/schedule/publish/delete, Analytics overview computed shape, Agents list). Frontend E2E: login via UI, sidebar nav to all 9 modules, create+score+delete a lead, generate a full strategy end-to-end and verified rendered result (Executive Summary, Personas, Channel Mix), analytics loaded, agents list rendered, logout works.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on initial mount (charts render inside not-yet-sized flex containers). Non-blocking but noisy in console. Suggest wrapping in a min-h-[300px] container or setting explicit minHeight on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: Optional: Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer sizing warnings by adding minHeight to chart wrappers on Analytics/Dashboard pages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py root path is only /api/ (not /api). Fine, but note there's no /api/health endpoint - consider adding one for uptime monitoring.
auth.py cookie samesite='none' + secure=True is correct for cross-site cookie via Kubernetes ingress. Good.
ai.py falls back to text generation on JSON error but never re-attempts JSON parsing on the fallback text; the _parse_json path still handles this. Acceptable.

server.py analytics month calculation uses (now.month - i - 1) % 12 + 1 which is correct for month wrap but year rollback logic '+ ((now.month - i - 1) // 12)' subtracts a year when needed - verified correct.
No pagination on list endpoints (leads/campaigns/content). For MVP fine (limits 100-500). Consider adding query pagination in future.
No role-based auth checks - all authenticated users have same access. Fine for MVP.
ObjectId(cid) is not wrapped in try/except - passing malformed id will throw 500 instead of 400/404. Minor robustness issue.
test_credentials: admin@marketing.ai / admin123 (verified working, cookie + bearer token both set)
seed_data_creation: seed_admin runs on lifespan startup; verified admin exists and password verifies. Test users (test_user_*@example.com) created & discarded during register test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend passes 14/14 pytest with real Groq (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) and Gemini image calls. AI endpoints take 5-30s. Frontend E2E validates all sidebar-nav-* testids, add-lead-btn, score-lead-*, generate-strategy-btn, submit-btn, logout-btn. No blocking bugs. Only minor Recharts sizing warnings in console.
